lines.say: This is Moment. A private journal of your days.
Log six kinds of moment: words, moods, photos, videos, voice notes, and places.
Each one is kept in its own place.
Home shows today in one calm feed. Logging a mood takes a single tap.
The calendar gives you the month at a glance, with a dot for everything you logged.
And search finds anything as you type, right on your phone.
Use it in light or dark, with glass or solid surfaces.
Everything is encrypted on your phone.
One optional switch can look up place names online. It stays off unless you turn it on.
Keep a backup in a single encrypted file, locked with a passphrase only you know.
